caption:
Creamy spinach eggs 
under 300 calorie breakfast 

Nutrition: 
C: 15 | F: 16 | P: 19
Calories: 269 per serving 
Serves 1

Ingredients
nobb of butter
2 eggs
6 cloves garlic, minced 
150 grams spinach
1 green chilli, thinly sliced 
1 tbsp cream ( shake it before us unlike what i did :p ) 
black pepper + salt, to taste
optional: 1 tsp chilli flakes + cheese, optional 

Method
add butter to the pan along with garlic and stir
add in the chopped spinach with minced green chilli and cook till the spinach is wilted
add in salt + pepper
follow that up with the cream and combine
crack in 2 eggs, cover and leave till the whites are cooked and yolks are still goooey! 
enjoy it as is or on some sourdough :)
